title: Ready or Not

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Ready or Not as a tactical shooter digital holding.

preservation.knownRevisions: Steam full release dated December 13, 2023 following Early Access. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.
